product_one_liner.value: Vectary is an online design platform for creative teams to develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI concept development and interactive 3D/AR; the company profile identifies creative teams as users.

pricing_page.notes: Vectary publishes a pricing page with Free, Starter, Team, and Business plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified as users/customers in Vectary’s success stories.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 18 employees, which falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile and TheJobsMap identify Redwood City, California, as headquarters; some third-party profiles differ, so this follows the company profile’s stated headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Vectary’s company profile gives 2014 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents marketing, product, workflow, and tutorial content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index contains multiple product guides, AI feature articles, and API/e-commerce documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board says Vectary has not added any jobs; TheJobsMap likewise reports no openings as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.value: Hunyuan 3.1, Hunyuan 3, Tripo H3.1, Tripo 2.5, Pixal 3D, Trellis 2, Trellis, Meshy 6, Meshy 5, and Rodin 2
model_provider.notes: Vectary’s documentation lists these as currently available AI models for image-to-3D generation.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page says Vectary is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified and complies with GDPR; GDPR is a compliance regime, not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook’s funding history lists a completed Series A on January 25, 2023, for $4.6 million as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is January 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: TheJobsMap reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026, and Wellfound lists no jobs.

launched_6mo.notes: Vectary Canvas launched on October 15, 2026, within six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Roberto Alvarez’s profile lists his Vectary CRO role ending in May 2026; a later profile describes him as having been CRO at Vectary.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vectary’s privacy policy names HubSpot among its service providers, providing a public CRM/marketing-stack signal.
